messages.text:
Renewal handoff / 更新メモ / ملاحظات التجديد

The January 31 order form covers 48 seats for twelve months. At $18.25 per seat per month, the monthly subtotal is $876 and the annual subtotal is $10,512. The quote lists tax separately. The quote expires January 28, so please have the corrected address on the final copy before the signer opens it.

The roster contains 41 seats assigned to active staff, four approved for incoming staff, and three reserved for the support rotation. The three support seats appear on a separate tab in the seat audit. The four incoming staff seats should appear on the order form even though their start dates fall in February. 合計は48席です。

The current invoice draft uses the old billing suite number. Procurement has the new suite number in its vendor record and can compare it with the correction when the next draft arrives. The payment contact and the purchase order line are already correct. عنوان الفوترة بانتظار التأكيد.

The quote lists two dates with different purposes. January 28 is the last day the current offer can be signed. January 31 is the date the new term begins. If billing issues a revision after January 28, please ask for a fresh validity date and record that date next to the revised quote number. The new term should still begin January 31 if the revised order form allows it.

The purchase order draft has one line for the annual seat total and a separate line for estimated tax. Finance reserved $10,512 for the seat line. If the revised quote changes the amount, please record the reason and send the new figures to Finance before anyone signs. One approval can cover the full annual amount once the corrected address is visible on the final quote.

Please check the renewal confirmation against the order form after both sides sign. Compare the start date, the 48-seat total, the $18.25 monthly unit price, and the billing address. Save the signed order form and the confirmation together. If a separate invoice arrives first, include its reference in the thread so the signer can identify the invoice that belongs to this order.

Operations can schedule seat assignments after the renewal confirmation arrives. The incoming staff receive their invitations on their individual start dates. The three support seats stay unassigned until the rotation lead posts the schedule. Please keep the seat audit with the January snapshot so the February figures can be reconciled with the order form. Примечание: три места оставлены для дежурной группы.

For the January 27 check-in, bring the latest quote and the corrected address from the vendor record. If billing has confirmed the change, post the quote number and the approval deadline here. If the correction is still pending, post who owns it and an expected delivery time. Si l’adresse est validée, merci d’indiquer la date de mise à jour dans ce fil.

The address correction is the remaining blocker. Procurement owns the follow-up, Finance owns approval of the annual seat amount, and Operations owns the February roster. Once the signed form is available, record the confirmation date here so the January 31 start can be checked against the billing record.
